reason: Shared pre-development checklist and quality-check conventions for repository changes.
Web package structure, commands, and frontend ownership boundaries for the new tests/unit/support layer.
Web test ownership, vitest/Playwright split, and prohibited fixed-time waits the migrated unit tests must keep respecting.
API test ownership, required coverage, and the PostgreSQL-backed test signatures the new test-app factory and row builders must compose with rather than replace.
Composition-root and dependency-direction rules that constrain test-app.ts to supplying services only and forbid a second assembly root.
Contracts package layout used to pick the domain modules that the new fixture factories are keyed to.
zod boundary rules: tests must import schemas through @imsweb/contracts subpaths and must never import zod directly.
Affected-workspace lanes and command ownership so the migration does not change how tests are discovered or run in CI.
